verdict.rationale: Runpod is a cloud GPU/infrastructure platform, not an AI agent — the evidence shows the opposite relationship: Runpod ships its own MCP servers so external coding agents can plug into and control Runpod (docs-3, docs-36, probe-3), rather than Runpod itself consuming external MCP servers to use their tools. Acting as an MCP client that 'uses other tools' agentic-ly is not a fit axis for an infrastructure/compute platform.
